name: MMSV
recent: MMS Ventures 在 2026 年 11 月 18 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的季度业绩，录得约 110 万令吉的亏损。此前，公司主席 Tan Hock Hin 在 2025 年 9 月至 11 月期间多次在公开市场增持公司股份。
notable: 公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度的亏损约 110 万令吉。
主席 Tan Hock Hin 于 2025 年 11 月 20 日及 21 日合计增持 82,800 股普通股。
risks: 最新季度录得亏损，净亏损率约 35.5%。
主席 Tan Hock Hin 在 2025 年 9 月至 11 月期间多次申报公开市场增持股份。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的季度营收为 278 万令吉，环比增长 64.4%，但同比下跌 74.3%；净亏损为 98.9 万令吉，净亏损率 35.5%，较上一季度的 169.9% 有所收窄。

recent_en: MMS Ventures announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 18 November 2026, posting a loss of about MYR 1.1 million. Earlier, Chairman Tan Hock Hin acquired shares in the open market multiple times between September and November 2025.
notable_en: Reported a loss of about MYR 1.1 million for the quarter ended 30 September 2026.
Chairman Tan Hock Hin acquired a total of 82,800 ordinary shares on 20 and 21 November 2025.
risks_en: Recorded a net loss for the latest quarter, with a net loss margin of about 35.5%.
Chairman Tan Hock Hin reported multiple open-market share acquisitions between September and November 2025.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 2.78 million, up 64.4% QoQ but down 74.3% YoY; net loss was MYR 0.99 million with a net loss margin of 35.5%, narrowing from 169.9% in the previous quarter.
